page_topic_one_liner: Add payments to vibe-coded SaaS — Payment Processor vs Merchant of Record vs PCI layer (Stripe, Paddle, Clink) with tax compliance and security pitfalls
differentiator_vs_generic: This is indie developer payment route selection for AI-built apps, NOT agentic payments protocol, NOT crypto checkout. Hero must be a three-path fork — PSP (you handle tax), MoR (platform handles tax), PCI middle layer — with checkout UI and subscription pricing blur.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Three-path payment fork diagram — left path PSP card with tax-form stack blur, center path MoR card with VAT-checkmark shield, right path PCI layer card with SAQ-A badge, all converging on hosted checkout mockup with credit card fields blur and $/month price blur
Vibe-coded app → payment gap visual: small deployed app window with $0 badge crossed, arrow to live checkout
Secondary: security warning triangle on AI-generated webhook code snippet blur (3 flaws motif)
anti_patterns: Crypto wallet or x402 agent payments (different article)
Generic shopping cart without PSP/MoR fork
Stripe logo or trademark payment brand marks
Tax form paperwork as sole hero without checkout context
